children.title: Path Dependence in Emergent Preference Formation

detail.title: Path Dependence in Emergent Preference Formation
detail.question: To what extent do early, stochastic interactions in learning environments constrain the long-term stable preferences of autonomous agents?
detail.reason: Attention is focused on emergent preferences; establishing whether early learning stages lock in preferences is critical for autonomous agent reliability.

children.title: Formalizing Value System Learning from Demonstrations

detail.title: Formalizing Value System Learning from Demonstrations
detail.question: How can formal value system learning from demonstrations be integrated with RLHF minimax game frameworks to improve autonomous agent alignment?
detail.reason: The identified sources provide distinct but compatible formalisms (RLHF as a minimax game vs. value system learning via multi-objective MDPs) that require synthesis to understand alignment mechanisms.
